# Collaborations

Bioconductor collaborates with training organisations to expand access to bioinformatics and data science education. These partnerships support instructor development, regional capacity building, and community-led teaching.

## Current Collaborations

- [The Carpentries](carpentries/) — Bioconductor is a member of The Carpentries, supporting instructor certification, train-the-trainer programmes, and global Carpentry workshops aligned with Bioconductor.
- [Physalia Courses](physalia/) — Co-branded courses taught by Bioconductor community instructors and hosted by Physalia, with free seats available for participants from underrepresented countries.

If you're interested in partnering with Bioconductor on training or outreach, please [get in touch](mailto:education@bioconductor.org).
